# OINK

> A local-first, Hugo-only theme for technical documentation

## Site index

- [Home page](http://localhost/index.md)
- [Docs](http://localhost/docs/index.md): Product guides, configuration, components, and deployment reference
- [Examples](http://localhost/examples/index.md): Build the bilingual starter, explore OINK features, and compare inherited Docsy references
- [Community](http://localhost/community/index.md)
- [Blog](http://localhost/blog/index.md): Docsy articles, OINK engineering stories, and OINK release notes
